origine_fr: L'homme 亻 et 足, écrit 口 sur 龰, qui donnait le son : presser, serrer. 足 se lit zú et ne donne plus le son cù. Presser quelqu'un : pousser, hâter.
origine_en: A person 亻 and 足, written 口 over 龰, which once gave the sound: to press, to squeeze. 足 is read zú and no longer gives the sound cù. Pressing someone: to urge, to hurry.
